subject: Request: Senior approvals for KiteBridge Hosted API pricing variance
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@kitebridge.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API proposal + pilot pricing

Ethan — great speaking this morning. Attached is a clean pricing worksheet and an outline for the 6-week pilot we discussed. High level:

- Pilot: free ingress + 50% credit for first 30 days to prove integration (no SLA)
- Production pricing (post-pilot) proposed: list price with a requested concession of 30% off standard Hosted API per-token rates for committed usage >= $180k/month for 12 months

I flagged this internally because the concession exceeds the standard discount band. KiteBridge is a strategic prospect (multi-region, potential to expand to Dedicated next year) and they've committed to an accelerated PO timeline if we can get support on price and a stricter SLA.

Attachments: KiteBridge_Pricing_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), KiteBridge_MA-Plan_Draft.docx (proposal)

Next steps: can you confirm the commercial terms on your side (procurement) and I'll start internal approval. Keen to keep momentum — they indicated a close by end of March if we can move quickly.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API proposal + pilot pricing — request for exec clearance

Forwarding Ben's note — KiteBridge is asking for 30% off list for a 12-month commit (>= $180k/mo). Asking for senior approval. Quick summary for review: 

- ARR run-rate if committed: ~$2.16M/year
- Requested discount: 30% off Hosted API token rates (sustained)
- Ask from customer: accelerated PO, cross-region failover, SLA target <200ms P95
- Upside: likely Dedicated evaluation in 2029 H2, references, potential marketplace listing

Mina — can you run margin impact (expected unit economics) and call out any mandatory guardrails (min term, overage caps, credit holdbacks, margin floor)?
Laura — need senior signoff for >20% concessions per pricing policy; if you want, I can propose a counter (25% + performance-based rebate) that protects revenue.

Ben attaching the pricing workbook. I put the timeline in the linked HubSpot deal (KB-2029-03-HOSTED-119).

Thanks — Kim
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-14T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API proposal + pilot pricing — margin / risk notes

Kim / team — reviewed the workbook and ran a scenario for a 30% concession: 

Key observations:
- At forecasted volumes (>= $180k/mo committed), gross margin on Hosted API line falls to ~28% before infra credits (below our preferred floor of 40% for hosted consumption).
- Break-even point (to maintain 40% gross margin) would require price only 20-22% concession OR additional paid add-ons (observability retention, support uplift) representing ~6-8% of ARR.
- Credit and SLA ask (200ms P95) implies higher infra SRE costs; recommend an SLA surcharge or performance rebate mechanism rather than permanent price step-down.

Recommended commercial guardrails if senior approves deeper discount: 
1) Authorize up to 25% one-time sustained concession, conditioned on 12-month minimum commitment and auto-escalation to list if usage drops below 75% of committed baseline for two consecutive months.
2) Include a performance-rebate clause: if P95 <200ms consistently for 90 days, apply an additional 2% rebate on the following quarter; if not, remove any further concession.
3) Attach upfront non-refundable onboarding credit of $50k to offset ramp costs.
4) Legal to require indemnity/cyber clauses and restrict data residency for EU workloads (if any).

If leadership wants to approve full 30%, Finance requests a mitigation plan (add-on revenue or higher commitment duration).

Mina
Head of Finance & RevOps | Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-15T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API proposal + pilot pricing — request for exec clearance

Thanks for the thorough notes. I reviewed the numbers and the strategic rationale. Approve a concession up to 25% (i.e., >20%) under the following mandatory conditions: 

1) 12-month minimum committed ARR of >= $180k/month executed via PO and counter-signed SOW prior to pilot completion.
2) Include the onboarding credit ($50k) as a one-time non-refundable fee applied to implementation services, not rate reduction.
3) Performance guardrails: include the rebate structure Mina proposed; if we miss performance targets, we reserve the right to revert to list pricing with 30 days notice.
4) Legal to include standard indemnity and data-residency language; any EU data processing must be on Dedicated or explicitly scoped.
5) Renewal review at month 9 to re-evaluate pricing and potential Dedicated migration.

Ben/Kim — you have permission to offer 25% today and to present the counter with these conditions. If KiteBridge insists on 30% flat with no guardrails, decline and offer the 25% + rebate construct. Please update HubSpot with the final commitment terms and send the attached SOW to DocuSign with the special pricing clause.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Approval_note_LB_20290315.txt (approval summary)]
